mapper.sql: id, shop_id, biz_date, channel, time_range, show_count, click_count, debit_cents, payload_json, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_promotion_ad_hourly_detail ( shop_id, biz_date, channel, time_range, show_count, click_count, debit_cents, payload_json, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{bizDate}, #{channel}, #{timeRange}, #{showCount}, #{clickCount}, #{debitCents}, #{payloadJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE show_count = VALUES(show_count), click_count = VALUES(click_count), debit_cents = VALUES(debit_cents), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
